user.title: Connect TapHome core
user.description: Expose your devices in the TapHome app (Settings → Expose devices → TapHome API) and enter the token below. For local access fill in the IP address of your core; leave both address fields empty to use the TapHome cloud.

data_description.ip: IP address of your TapHome core, e.g. 192.168.1.3.
data_description.api_url: Advanced: full API URL of the core. Fill in either the IP address or the API URL, not both.
data_description.token: Authorization token shown at the top of the TapHome API screen.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure TapHome core
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings of your TapHome core.

data_description.ip: IP address of your TapHome core, e.g. 192.168.1.3.
data_description.api_url: Advanced: full API URL of the core. Fill in either the IP address or the API URL, not both.
data_description.token: Authorization token shown at the top of the TapHome API screen.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate TapHome
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} is no longer valid. Enter a new token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the TapHome core.
error.invalid_auth: The TapHome core rejected the token.
error.ip_and_api_url_set: Fill in either the IP address or the API URL, not both.

abort.already_configured: This TapHome core is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The connected core does not match the core this entry was created for.

device_not_exposed.title: Device {device_id} not exposed for core{core_id}
device_not_exposed.description: Device {device_id} configured for core{core_id} is not exposed in the TapHome API. Please check your TapHome setup.

core_unavailable.title: Connection to TapHome core{core_id} failed
core_unavailable.description: Home Assistant cannot communicate with the TapHome core{core_id}.

ip_and_api_url_set.title: Both api_url and ip set for core{core_id}
ip_and_api_url_set.description: Both api_url and ip are configured for core{core_id}. api_url will be used.

device_type_mismatch.title: Unsupported type for device {device_id} in core{core_id}
device_type_mismatch.description: Device {device_id} is type {device_type} with supported values [{supported_values}] but expected: {expected}. Please check your TapHome setup.

yaml_deprecated.title: TapHome YAML configuration is deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description: Your TapHome YAML configuration has been imported and the integration is now managed in the UI (Settings → Devices & services). Remove the taphome section from configuration.yaml — changes made there are no longer applied.
